Quick context: Eon Health is ready to move their 3-month pilot to production. They are asking for a temporary relaxation of our standard uptime SLO to 99.5% (from 99.9%) for the pilot window with the following commercial offsets:

- A 12% usage discount for the duration of the pilot (90 days)
- Service-credit cap of 2x monthly fees (vs standard 3x)
- Agreed remediation steps (dedicated on-call + twice-weekly syncs)

Attached: SLO proposal (slo-proposal-eonhealth.pdf).

They've signed the data processing addendum; procurement wants a single-sentence remedy clause in the order form to reflect the pilot tolerance. Legal/Deal Desk: we need an exec waiver for the uptime delta and the reduced credit cap. Can we get signoff this week? Deal: EON-4521.

Next steps I recommend:
1) Legal quick redline to the remedy language (attached)
2) Exec signoff on the 99.5% pilot SLO + 12% discount
3) DocuSign link to be sent once approved

Thanks,
